# E0805: a host example does not bind as its record declares

A playground deployment registers examples of its own beside thema's, and
each declares whether its lineage binds: an example of an error does not.
Registering an example binds its lineage, and refuses it when the outcome
differs from what it declares; the notes say what binding it reported. The
other examples in the request are registered regardless.

## Example

`request.json`:

```json
{"examples": [{"example": {"id": "pets/empty", "title": "empty", "category": "Pets", "summary": "", "kind": "", "binds": true}, "lineage": {"normal": {"path": "lineage.cue", "text": "name: \"empty\"\nschemas: {}\n"}}}]}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0805]: host example "pets/empty" is declared to bind, but does not
  |
  = note: binding it reports E0122: the lineage declares no schemas
  = help: fix the lineage, or set binds to false if the example is meant to show an error
```
